title: The Why the Song Had a Rest
youtube_title: The Why the Song Had a Rest | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Remy about explanation of why a song needed a rest in the middle. Remy wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
